name: EPIC 211959925
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 16, 15.9 solar radii and 1.04 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211959925 (K2 campaign 16): PARAM radius (solar radii) 15.901752 (16th-84th percentiles 14.931346-16.980475), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211959925: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4563.201 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

text.card: A red giant 8,553 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 1.04 solar masses and 15.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,563 K at its surface.
